title: Notification that says you missed notifications because of "Do not disturb", should mention that it was triggered by being in fullscreen mode
line: When you leave a fullscreen app, the missed-notifications summary now says Do Not Disturb was on because a fullscreen application was focused.
explanation: The notifications applet folds every Do Not Disturb reason (manual, timed, app inhibition, mirrored screens, focused fullscreen window) into a single inhibited flag, and Notifications::showInhibitionSummary() only received that, so the summary could never say why Do Not Disturb was on. The applet now keeps the non-fullscreen reasons in their own binding and remembers whether, for the whole time Do Not Disturb was on, a focused fullscreen window was the only reason. showInhibitionSummary() gains an optional inhibitedByFullscreen argument (default false, so other callers are unchanged) and uses a new string that adds "because a fullscreen application was focused" in that case.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: say when Do Not Disturb was due to fullscreen

The summary of notifications missed during Do Not Disturb never said why
it was on, which is confusing when it was turned on by a fullscreen app.
Track whether only fullscreen inhibited them and mention it in the text.

BUG: 507073
